title: bazel 0.4.5 extra actions broken with sandboxing
body:
Please provide the following information. The more we know about your system and use case, the more easily and likely we can help.

### Description of the problem / feature request / question:

Running extra actions fails in bazel 0.4.5. Things were working in bazel 0.4.3.

In the below example, "--config=tidy" adds --experimental_action_listener to run a clang-tidy-3.8 wrapper program.

```
bazel build --config=tidy -- //foo:bar
ERROR: /foo/BUILD:6:1: Executing extra_action //build/clang_tidy:clang_tidy_action on //foo:bar failed: Process exited with status 1 [sandboxed].
error: error reading '/.../5c346b5e4b6390e1d6c311b5361d6719/bazel-sandbox/d83eb7c2-495e-4025-9d4f-ffadff309d35-13/execroot/foo/foo/bar.cc' [clang-diagnostic-error]
1 error generated.
Error while processing /.../5c346b5e4b6390e1d6c311b5361d6719/bazel-sandbox/d83eb7c2-495e-4025-9d4f-ffadff309d35-13/execroot/foo/foo/bar.cc.
clang_tidy_runner: ERROR: Build error. See https://gerrit/g/plugins/gitiles/build/+/master/clang_tidy/README.md for details
Use --strategy=clang_tidy_action=standalone to disable sandboxing for the failing actions.
WARNING: Cannot delete sandbox directory after action execution: /.../5c346b5e4b6390e1d6c311b5361d6719/bazel-sandbox/d83eb7c2-495e-4025-9d4f-ffadff309d35-24 (java.io.IOException: /.../5c346b5e4b6390e1d6c311b5361d6719/bazel-sandbox/d83eb7c2-495e-4025-9d4f-ffadff309d35-24/execroot/foo (Device or resource busy)).
```

The suggested workaround of using standalone seems to work.

### If possible, provide a minimal example to reproduce the problem:


### Environment info
* Operating System:

Ubuntu-based Linux, running bazel inside a Docker container providing Ubuntu 16.04.2 LTS

* Bazel version (output of `bazel info release`):

release 0.4.5

* If `bazel info release` returns "development version" or "(@non-git)", please tell us what source tree you compiled Bazel from; git commit hash is appreciated (`git rev-parse HEAD`):

N/A

###  Have you found anything relevant by searching the web?
(e.g. [StackOverflow answers](http://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/bazel),
[GitHub issues](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues),
email threads on the [`bazel-discuss`](https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/bazel-discuss) Google group)


### Anything else, information or logs or outputs that would be helpful?
(If they are large, please upload as attachment or provide link).
